item.text:
{
  "packet_id": "H7-T03-2",
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "C001",
      "fields": ["state", "operation"],
      "proposition": "The proposed reconstruction concerns a particular sampled first order, its fulfillment, the product or container received, subsequent customer handling, and any refill attempt or second order.",
      "scope": "Order-specific histories; reconstruction with customers is limited to consenting participants.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P001"}, {"source_id": "P009"}],
      "ambiguity": "The proposed linkage is not asserted to be achievable for every sampled order."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C002",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "The target counterpart of custody comprises the documented passage of the particular order and product through service and customer handling, together with the provenance of evidence about those events.",
      "scope": "The mapping's correspondence between custody and order-specific service histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}],
      "ambiguity": "The correspondence encompasses both handling history and evidence provenance without specifying separate continuity standards for them."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C003",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Whether existing records support reliable customer and order linkage is unknown.",
      "scope": "Existing records before the proposed linkage check.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P003"}],
      "ambiguity": "Neither the available identifiers nor a reliability threshold is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C004",
      "fields": ["state", "operation"],
      "proposition": "Customer and order linkage must be checked during week one.",
      "scope": "The initial inquiry into whether reliable linkage is possible.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P003"}, {"source_id": "P005"}],
      "ambiguity": "The method and acceptance criteria for the check are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C005",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Nonpurchase at eight weeks is an outcome requiring explanation and does not itself identify a break in handling.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of an absent second order at eight weeks.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C006",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Nonpurchase at eight weeks does not itself establish dissatisfaction.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of an absent second order at eight weeks.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C007",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The proposed cohort comparison uses cohorts with a full eight weeks of observation and consistent definitions of first and second orders.",
      "scope": "The week-one cohort comparison.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P005"}],
      "ambiguity": "The order definitions and cohort boundaries are not supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C008",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Starter-container status should be established only where records or customers support it.",
      "scope": "Classification of sampled orders or customers during the inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P006"}],
      "ambiguity": "The required strength of support and treatment of conflicting sources are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C009",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The limited follow-up sample should span purchasers and nonpurchasers, promotion exposure, and fulfillment routes, including the new collection points.",
      "scope": "Selection for the proposed voluntary follow-up.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P007"}],
      "ambiguity": "No sample size, allocation, or claim of representativeness is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C010",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Participation in customer follow-up is voluntary, and customer history reconstruction and proposed random assignment are limited to consenting participants.",
      "scope": "Customer participation in the inquiry and any randomized communication trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P008"}, {"source_id": "P009"}, {"source_id": "P017"}],
      "ambiguity": "The consent procedure is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C011",
      "fields": ["operation", "limit"],
      "proposition": "Clarification and further customer contact must remain within agreed follow-up, without repeated unsolicited contact.",
      "scope": "Initial follow-up, clarification, and later contact concerning mature outcomes.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P008"}, {"source_id": "P014"}, {"source_id": "P040"}],
      "ambiguity": "The permitted frequency and duration of agreed follow-up are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C012",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Each documented transfer or handling event should retain its actor or reporting source, time or explicitly uncertain interval, purpose, order/product/container linkage, and supporting evidence.",
      "scope": "Documentation of reconstructed events.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P010"}],
      "ambiguity": "A responsible actor and a reporting source are allowed alternatives; the sentence does not require both to be known."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C013",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The inquiry should ask about stock, expected depletion, leaks, collection access, and refill understanding without presuming a cause.",
      "scope": "Questions to participating customers.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P011"}],
      "ambiguity": "The listed topics are inquiry topics, not established explanations."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C014",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Existing records, customer recollections, and unresolved discrepancies should remain distinguishable in the reconstructed evidence.",
      "scope": "Treatment of evidence in the proposed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P012"}],
      "ambiguity": "No hierarchy for resolving disagreement between records and recollections is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C015",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Findings should remain traceable to their sources, with corrections retained.",
      "scope": "Provenance and revision history of inquiry findings.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mechanism for retaining sources and corrections is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C016",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Access to identifiable histories should be restricted.",
      "scope": "Identifiable customer and order histories created or used by the inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}],
      "ambiguity": "Authorized users and access controls are not specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C017",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "Unresolved links, including a missing use history, remain documentation gaps.",
      "scope": "Classification of missing or unresolved history evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P014"}, {"source_id": "P021"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify how much missing information constitutes a consequential gap."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C018",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The proposed intervention is bounded to at most one reversible fulfillment or communication change, selected by the end of week one and run for the remaining four weeks.",
      "scope": "Any intervention selected under the five-week decision schedule.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}, {"source_id": "P017"}],
      "ambiguity": "Reversibility and the boundaries of a single change are not operationally defined."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C019",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "A process change should address an actionable, corroborated, traceable difficulty within the permitted scope; if evidence identifies no such actionable process, no speculative change should be made.",
      "scope": "The week-one decision whether to initiate a fulfillment or communication change.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}, {"source_id": "P018"}],
      "ambiguity": "The thresholds for actionable evidence, corroboration, and traceability are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C020",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Revised refill instructions should be trialed only if histories connect confusing instructions with failed or abandoned refill attempts.",
      "scope": "The mapping's example of an evidence-conditioned communication trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P016"}],
      "ambiguity": "This is an example, not a selected intervention; the required strength of the connection is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C021",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "If feasible, eligible consenting customers should be randomly assigned to changed or usual communication.",
      "scope": "A proposed communication comparison during the four-week trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P017"}],
      "ambiguity": "Feasibility and eligibility are undefined; this does not assert that randomization will occur."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C022",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "The proposed continuity signal is an internally consistent history linking the order, received product, relevant service encounters, and examined evidence.",
      "scope": "Inspection of reconstructed order histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P019"}],
      "ambiguity": "No operational threshold for continuity or internal consistency is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C023",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Dispatch and collection records might corroborate a participant's account of receiving the same order.",
      "scope": "An illustrative possible corroboration within an order history.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P020"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping proposes a possible connection; it reports no actual corroboration."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C024",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Contradictions in a reconstructed history might concern receipt dates, quantities, or which purchase supplied the product being discussed.",
      "scope": "Illustrative possible discrepancies in order and product histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P020"}],
      "ambiguity": "These are possible contradiction types, not observed discrepancies or an exhaustive list."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C025",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Reported stock remaining, anticipated refill timing, specific difficulties, and refill attempts should be recorded separately with their sources and uncertainty.",
      "scope": "Substantive customer reports collected alongside reconstructed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P022"}],
      "ambiguity": "The sentence does not fully specify whether 'separately' distinguishes these reports from continuity evidence, from one another, or both."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C026",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "Trial documentation should distinguish assignment, actual receipt by the intended customer, completion of the identified step, and subsequent ordering.",
      "scope": "Assignment where used, and proposed trial exposure and outcome observations.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P017"}, {"source_id": "P023"}],
      "ambiguity": "The affected step and observation windows for these measures are not specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C027",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "The listed history and trial observations are proposed observations, not established findings.",
      "scope": "The observations described in the signal field.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P024"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C028",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Documentary continuity supports attributing an examined experience or trial exposure to the intended first order.",
      "scope": "Order-specific attribution supported by a continuous documentary history.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "The strength of support is unspecified; continuity is not presented as proof."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C029",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Documentary continuity accounts for the order's documented handling history.",
      "scope": "The handling history represented in the documentation.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "'Accounts for' is limited to documented handling and does not assert completeness of actual events."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C030",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Reliably linked remaining stock can support delayed need as an explanation for that household.",
      "scope": "A household-specific explanation where the remaining stock is reliably linked to the relevant order.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P026"}],
      "ambiguity": "No amount of stock, depletion threshold, or sufficient evidential standard is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C031",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A documented unsuccessful collection or refill attempt can support a particular inconvenience as an explanation.",
      "scope": "The particular documented experience within the linked-history inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P026"}],
      "ambiguity": "The statement provides possible support, not proof of an exclusive cause of nonpurchase."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C032",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Neither the linked-stock explanation nor the documented-inconvenience explanation establishes how much of the overall repeat-purchase decline it accounts for.",
      "scope": "Extrapolation from the particular explanations described in P026 to the aggregate decline.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P027"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C033",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Gaps in the documented history weaken attribution.",
      "scope": "Attribution that depends on the missing linkage.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P028"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not quantify how different gaps affect attribution."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C034",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A gap calls for clarification or exclusion from conclusions that require the missing link.",
      "scope": "Handling conclusions dependent on unresolved linkage.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P028"}],
      "ambiguity": "The choice between clarification and exclusion is not specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C035",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A documentation gap should not be classified as dissatisfaction.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of gaps in reconstructed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P028"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C036",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "At week five, the retain-or-revert decision for the single change should use verified exposure, completion of the affected step, participant accounts, and operational burden.",
      "scope": "The bounded decision about an implemented trial change.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P029"}],
      "ambiguity": "No weighting, success threshold, or rule resolving disagreement among these inputs is supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C037",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A credible randomized comparison can strengthen a narrow causal claim about the measured step.",
      "scope": "A randomized comparison that is credible, concerning the step actually measured.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P030"}],
      "ambiguity": "Credibility is not operationally defined, and the claim does not specify an effect direction or magnitude."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C038",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "The purchasing commitment should remain provisional with respect to any claimed repeat-purchase uplift.",
      "scope": "The purchasing decision under the current inquiry and trial timetable.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P031"}],
      "ambiguity": "The practical form and degree of provisionality are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C039",
      "fields": ["inference", "limit"],
      "proposition": "Purchasing at five weeks should be based on explicit scenarios using observed orders and explicitly uncertain future refill demand, rather than an assumed recovery.",
      "scope": "The purchasing commitment due at five weeks.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P031"}, {"source_id": "P040"}],
      "ambiguity": "No scenario values, probabilities, calculation method, or purchasing rule is supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C040",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A complete history does not prove truthful reporting.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of documentary completeness.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C041",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A complete history does not prove accurate recall.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of documentary completeness where recollection contributes evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C042",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A complete history does not prove the absence of unrecorded events.",
      "scope": "The relationship between the documented history and actual events.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C043",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A documentation gap does not prove a service failure.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of missing history evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C044",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A documentation gap does not prove product alteration.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of missing history evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C045",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Reliability depends on identifier quality, recording practices, preservation of sources, and safeguards against mistaken linkage.",
      "scope": "Reliability of the documented histories and their linkage.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": "The relative contribution and required standard of each dependency are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C046",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Voluntary participants and support correspondents may differ from silent customers.",
      "scope": "Selection into follow-up participation or support correspondence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P034"}],
      "ambiguity": "The existence, direction, and size of any differences are not established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C047",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Given possible differences from silent customers, explanation frequencies among voluntary participants and support correspondents do not estimate population prevalence.",
      "scope": "Population interpretation of explanations observed in those selected groups.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P034"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping specifies no adjustment or sampling design that would support population estimation."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C048",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Promotions and collection-point openings coincided.",
      "scope": "The changes relevant to the observed repeat-purchase decline.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify their exact dates or degree of overlap."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C049",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "The coincidence of promotions and collection-point openings prevents a simple before-and-after attribution.",
      "scope": "Attribution of the observed change using a simple temporal comparison.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The sentence does not specify an alternative attribution method or establish which concurrent change mattered."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C050",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Quantity purchased does not establish consumption speed.",
      "scope": "Inference about household product use from order quantities.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P036"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C051",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Four weeks of trial follow-up cannot establish an eight-week repeat-purchase effect for new trial entrants.",
      "scope": "New entrants observed during the proposed four-week trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P037"}],
      "ambiguity": "The limit is specifically about new trial entrants and an eight-week effect; other observation histories are not characterized."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C052",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "If an individual withdraws, follow-up with that individual must stop.",
      "scope": "Individual participation in follow-up.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P038"}],
      "ambiguity": "The sentence does not specify consequences for previously collected records."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C053",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "The trial should be suspended for credible increased harm or service disruption.",
      "scope": "Continuation of the proposed trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P038"}],
      "ambiguity": "Credibility and suspension thresholds are unspecified; the grammatical reach of 'credible' across the two triggers is not explicit."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C054",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "If exposure, identity, or outcome linkage cannot be established for cases, no effect should be inferred from those cases.",
      "scope": "Case-based effect inference requiring those links.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P039"}],
      "ambiguity": "The standard for establishing each link is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C055",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Explanations that remain unresolved at five weeks should be reported as unresolved.",
      "scope": "Reporting at the purchasing decision deadline.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P040"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C056",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Mature repeat-order outcomes should be assessed later using routine records.",
      "scope": "Outcome assessment after the five-week decision point.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P040"}],
      "ambiguity": "The later assessment date and exact maturity criterion are not specified in this sentence."
    }
  ],
  "coverage": [
    {
      "field": "state",
      "claim_ids": ["C001", "C002", "C003", "C004", "C005", "C006"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P001-P004 are represented through the order-specific reconstruction unit, custody correspondence, unknown linkage reliability, required check, and separate limits on interpreting nonpurchase. The opening imperative supplies setup for the proposed history and is not treated as evidence that a history already exists."
    },
    {
      "field": "operation",
      "claim_ids": ["C001", "C004", "C007", "C008", "C009", "C010", "C011", "C012", "C013", "C014", "C015", "C016", "C017", "C018", "C019", "C020", "C021", "C026"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P005-P018 are covered for comparison conditions, supported classification, sampling scope, participation and contact bounds, provenance practices, inquiry neutrality, intervention bounds, evidence-conditioned selection, and conditional randomization. Examining quantity, product, discount, and fulfillment in P006 is routine comparison setup without a stated finding or additional rationale. The ordering-to-refill stages in P009 and recording items in P010 specify the reconstruction procedure; they are retained within the relevant propositions rather than split into claims for each stage or data item."
    },
    {
      "field": "signal",
      "claim_ids": ["C017", "C022", "C023", "C024", "C025", "C026", "C027"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P019-P024 are covered for continuity, possible corroboration and contradiction, documentation gaps, separately sourced substantive reports, distinct trial observations, and their proposed rather than established character. Individual example dates, quantities, report topics, and trial measures are not each treated as an additional conclusion."
    },
    {
      "field": "inference",
      "claim_ids": ["C028", "C029", "C030", "C031", "C032", "C033", "C034", "C035", "C036", "C037", "C038", "C039"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P025-P031 are covered for attribution, documented handling accountability, household-specific explanatory support, aggregate limits, consequences of gaps, the retain-or-revert decision, conditional causal strengthening, and provisional scenario-based purchasing. P026's statement that explanations become more discriminating is represented by its two specified explanatory relations rather than duplicated as a separate general conclusion. The decision inputs in P029 remain one decision rule, with no invented threshold or weighting."
    },
    {
      "field": "limit",
      "claim_ids": ["C011", "C039", "C040", "C041", "C042", "C043", "C044", "C045", "C046", "C047", "C048", "C049", "C050", "C051", "C052", "C053", "C054", "C055", "C056"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "P032-P040 are covered for separately contestable reporting, recall, completeness, failure, and alteration limits; reliability dependencies; selection differences and prevalence inference; coincident changes and attribution; consumption and follow-up limits; stopping conditions; effect-linkage requirements; unresolved reporting; and later assessment. Repeated purchasing and contact bounds are consolidated with their earlier formulations. Reliability factors remain one dependency proposition, and routine later record use remains part of the deferred assessment proposal."
    }
  ]
}
